cases.description: Cases. Order is not semantic; consumers sort by `id`.

identity.description: Where the snapshot came from and the digest of its cases.

Case.description: One evaluation case: a fixture file plus its authored expectations.

content.description: Exact fixture text. Ranges index its UTF-8 bytes.

expected.description:
Authored spans, sorted by `start` and pairwise disjoint (touching is allowed).
Empty for controls.

grouping.description: Grouping metadata (kind, tier, family, ...). Never changes an outcome.

id.description: Stable case id, unique within the snapshot.

path.description: Relative path the fixture is materialized at, unique within the snapshot.

twin.description: Present when this case is an authored negative twin of a positive case.

oneOf.description: Contains secret spans that must be covered.
A control: any (scoped) finding is a false alarm.

Contains spans whose handling is a policy matter; scored like
`must-redact` but grouped separately.

Envelope.description:
An authored acceptable envelope around a span: a wider range a finding may
cover without being `OVERBROAD`. The reason is authored evidence.

end.description: Exclusive end byte offset (`>=` the span end).

reason.description: Why the wider range is acceptable. Must be non-blank.

start.description: Inclusive start byte offset (`<=` the span start).

EvidenceTier.description:
Evidence tier of a case's expectation. `T0` means the expectation is
pending review: the case is observed but never scored.

envelope.description: Optional wider acceptable range with an authored reason.

role.description: Whether the span is the credential itself or an acceptable companion.

Grouping.description: Grouping metadata. Used to partition measurements, never to decide them.

evidence_class.description: Evidence class label from the evidence source, if any.

family.description:
Credential family (format contract) the case exercises, if any. A twin's
false-alarm reading is scoped to this family.

group.description: Corpus group / category the case belongs to.

targets.description: Families the case targets (reporting strata only). Sorted, unique.

SnapshotIdentity.description: Identity of the evidence a snapshot was taken from.

evidence_schema.description: Schema/revision label of the source evidence format.

revision.description: Immutable revision of the source (commit SHA or release tag).

source.description:
Evidence source, e.g. `credential-evidence` or
`legacy:redact-secret-benchmarks` during migration.

oneOf.description: Credential bytes that must be covered. Scored by the lattice.

Bytes that may be covered without collateral (e.g. a paired key id).
Not scored as a span; counts as acceptable coverage.

TwinLineage.description: Lineage of an authored negative twin.

mutation.description: Authored description of the single semantic change. Non-blank.

twin_of.description: The positive case this control is paired with.
